info.title: ReMatch Match Intelligence API
info.description: Tool contract derived from the ReMatch FastAPI application. It exposes read-only match and decision data plus a non-persisting claim evidence/reference validation operation. Match and event data currently shipped with the API is synthetic.

servers.description: Live Azure Container Apps backend (East US). Requires Authorization: Bearer <API_BEARER_TOKEN>.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search team names, short names, or competition
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search team names, short names, or competition

get.description: Discover available matches. Use the returned IDs and provenance as the source of truth; follow pagination when additional matches are relevant.
Fetch a known match by ID. Use this to confirm the selected match, its teams, status, synthetic provenance, and scenario before analyzing an event.

List events for a known match to discover valid event IDs. Follow the returned pagination fields when there are more events than the page contains. Use event IDs from this response for decision analysis.

Get the backend's analysis for an observed match event. Preserve returned scoring method ID and version, scores, ranks, provenance, limitations, and verified claim statuses. Scores are geometric estimates, not probabilities or proof of the best real-world decision.

Return one backend decision analysis, its evidence/reference validation results, and the deterministic English and Arabic narrative. evidenceValidationStatus reflects reference/calculation checks only; claimSupportStatus is always not_assessed. This operation does not verify natural-language truth. geometric_progression_v1 is not xG or a pass-success probability.

Fetch the registered evidence bundle for a decision analysis, including claims, evidence references, calculation IDs, frame IDs, event IDs, limitations, and provenance. Report missing evidence explicitly.

post.description: Validate submitted evidence references and registered calculation values against the selected match/event evidence. The legacy status and evidenceValidationStatus report this validation only; claimSupportStatus is always not_assessed because natural-language truth is not evaluated. Valid references do not prove the statement true. geometric_progression_v1 is not xG or a pass-success probability.

schema.title: Response Verify Decision Claims Api V1 Matches  Match Id  Events  Event Id  Decision Analysis Verify Post

get.description: Return a bilingual evidence-grounded briefing for any stored match event. Distinguishes verified facts, calculated metrics, and hypotheses. Uses deterministic templates with optional server-side LLM enrichment when configured. llmConnected is true only after a successful validated provider call; never invent players, assists, or causal links absent from the record.
